This is not new violation debt -- it is admitting an already-admitted category's known run-to-run variance into the aggregate so the gate does not flake the moment clearance reaches 501. Both numbers remain debt against _goal error_ceiling: 0, not an accepted end state: the honest reading is that this board has 32 places where an HV creepage requirement is not met, invisible until measured this way.
